Messages.Author: Lupus Australis
Messages.Body:
Get a Raven Spy or Sport Bike, preferably transfered from a weenie via
Heidelberg as soon as you come out.
Put Covenant of Blood in play
Play Haven Uncovered

Enter combat with the Haven
Play Trap and Drawing out the Beast at Superior
Stay at Long Range each round
If the Trap threatens to run out, Play another DOTB
Just before the DOTB is about to send him to torpor, play Majesty at
Superior, paying 1 blood to untap

Attack another minion with Bum's Rush
Repeat above cycle, playing Majesty to untap

Attack another minion with Ambush
Repeat above combat, playing Majesty to Untap

Attack a Camarilla Vampire with Covenant of Blood
Repeat

Continue to do the same when Blocking, always staying untapped with
Majesty

Lupus Australis

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <36459...@news.ip.pt>, Luis P. Duarte <Luis....@ip.pt>
writes

>I think there's a problem:
>After you played Bum's Rush, i think you can't play
>Ambush with the same minion... i'm thinking in bleeding
>with GtU, untap somehow and bleed again with Legal
>Manipulations... LSJ?

Bleed is a defined action type. Entering combat is not. Bum's Rush,
Wynn's inbuilt special, Ambush, Haven Uncovered, Imperial Decree's rush,
Bloodhunt (the card) rush, Archon's built in rush, and so forth are all
considered different actions.

--

OK, but the whole point to using Cailean is that he never needs maneuvers
to stay at range. He can play trap and draw out the combat as long as he
likes, and never worry about running out of maneuvers and being brought to
close range. His majesties will be all but unstoppable. The elimination
of maneuvers will give his deck a focus which cannot be duplicated.
